verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Files On-Demand in Windows File Explorer, pinning files with "Always keep on this device", folder backup, and cross-device access online or offline. Hands-on reports are mixed on whether sync "just works": some users report deleted, reverted or corrupted files and poor performance with git repos, while others report years of trouble-free multi-machine sync. Missing for 10: any evidence of an official macOS desktop client, explicit selective-sync (choose folders) documentation, and consistent independent corroboration of sync reliability.
